name: Stegosaurus
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A heavy four-legged dinosaur with a small head, two rows of raised plates on its back, and long spikes on its elevated tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, First printing, September 2017, printed p. 231, p. 232. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/toa/monsters-and-npcs
sections.Actions: Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit against one target within 10 ft. A hit deals 26 (6d6 + 5) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter notes: Stegosaurs travel in mixed-age herds. The lone animal in Appendix B is curious and approaches. It swipes with its tail if anyone touches it.

name: Velociraptor
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A turkey-sized, feathered dinosaur with a narrow toothy head, two long clawed hind legs, feathered forelimbs and a long tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, First printing, September 2017, printed p. 235, p. 236. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/toa/monsters-and-npcs
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. When an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not incapacitated, attack rolls against that creature have advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Encounter notes: The Appendix B ambush uses a pack of 3d6 velociraptors. Roll one Dexterity (Stealth) check with advantage for the pack. A character whose passive Perception equals or exceeds the roll is not surprised.

name: Wild Dog
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A lean wild canid with tall rounded ears, long legs, and irregular charcoal, ochre and cream patches.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, First printing, September 2017, printed p. 96, p. 97. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/toa/dwellers-of-the-forbidden-city Uses Jackal, Monster Manual (2014), printed p. 331. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16936-jackal
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing or smell have advantage.
Pack Tactics. When an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not incapacitated, attack rolls against that creature have advantage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter notes: Six wild dogs feed on a body in the Walled Compound. The dogs leave characters alone while they keep their distance.

name: Zebra
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A compact equine with black and pale stripes, a short upright mane, rounded ears and a thin tufted tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Tomb of Annihilation, First printing, September 2017, printed p. 106, p. 107. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/toa/dwellers-of-the-forbidden-city Uses Riding Horse, Monster Manual (2014), printed p. 336. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16997-riding-horse
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Encounter notes: Wongo’s Shrine gives the Zebra the Riding Horse statistics. When the shrine masks deliver their curse, anyone who looked through one in the last hour makes a DC 15 Constitution save. A failed save transforms the viewer into the animal on the last mask they used, as polymorph. The curse ends after 24 hours.
sections.Base-stat erratum: First-print Monster Manual p. 336 gives Hooves +2 to hit for the Riding Horse. The official errata had corrected it to +5 by 2016. The 2017 Zebra reference uses the corrected Riding Horse block.
